name: Sable Fix Core 1.5.0
body:
## v1.5.0 — Non-blocking scans

- ⚡ **Zero main-thread IO**: the very first panel scan now runs on a background pool too — opening the panel never stalls the server, even on a 589-file world
- 🔄 panel shows a pulsing scanning card and auto-refreshes (~2 s) until the scan completes
- 🛡️ protocol: PanelData gains a scanning flag (backwards-incompatible with 1.4.0 panel packets — update both sides)

## 中文
- ⚡ **主线程零 IO**：首次面板扫描也进后台线程池 — 打开面板不再卡服，589 文件的世界照样秒开
- 🔄 面板显示脉冲「扫描中」卡片，扫描完成自动刷新（约 2 秒重试）
- 🛡️ 协议：PanelData 新增 scanning 标志（与 1.4.0 面板包不兼容，请双端同更新）
